status: UI-SR-1 corrected in source; no remaining actionable defect found in the narrow queue/dismissal/completion flow. Native GUI acceptance remains incomplete.
scope: Read-only re-review of StudioSession pending request state and lines 321 through 352, plus the existing RebaseApp onDismiss connection. This addendum closes the stale-context finding from the prior UI review without replacing or modifying that historical record.

closed_finding.previous_risk: An event UUID alone could identify an event in a different import of the same CPR, and mutable current project/root were read after native-panel completion.
current_behavior: The queued request captures eventID, a Project value snapshot and the project root URL when rendering is requested.
The queued request is cleared before presentation, preserving consume-once behavior across repeated dismissal callbacks and cancellation.
Before showing the panel, current Project equality and root URL equality must match the captured request, and its event must exist in the captured Project.
The native panel is opened asynchronously through begin completion after the SwiftUI sheet onDismiss callback; there is no runModal invocation in this path.
The completion captures self weakly. Cancellation, missing destination or session deallocation returns without rendering.
On OK, current Project/root are compared again with the request. A changed context produces an error and returns before core rendering.
The renderer receives the captured Project and root, not a newly selected mutable current project. Its existing preserved-source replay and actual-media snapshot/hash checks still apply.
closed_finding.limits: This is a source-level state-flow review. AppKit presentation, focus, repeated-open/cancel behavior and the previously disabled native dialog have not been observed working by this reviewer.

validation.core_log_scope: The core log is unchanged and is not evidence of native dialog behavior. No new reviewer test process was started.

remaining_scope_limits: The prior inspection-readiness caveat remains: existence of an attachment row does not itself validate current attached-file/hash/PCM24 RIFF readiness. Rendering still checks those conditions before publication.
